reason: I have 20 clients and every one needs their own books. A single sheet with everyone's receipts mixed together is just another mess for me to sort out. And at my volume, easily 600-800 notas a month, I'm past the $79 plan, which is way too much on what I earn.
objection: It looks built for one business owner, not a bookkeeper. I can't see how I'd keep 20 clients in separate sheets and reports, and most of what I get is crumpled paper nota I'd have to photograph first anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A bookkeeper plan: one login, a separate sheet and report for each client, priced for my whole practice at around $25 a month, not per document.
